title: Drifting, Discriminating, and Directioning for Action Coordination in Higher-dimensional Action Space
title_zh: 漂移、判别与定向：高维动作空间中的动作协同
abstract_en: This paper proposes a lightweight policy model to mitigate the difficulty of handling higher-dimensional action spaces in reinforcement learning (RL), alongside an algorithm to effectively train it. To address this, we focus on drifting models, which can implicitly represent complex distributions and infer actions in a single forward pass. However, while drifting models can be straightforwardly trained via backpropagation of the Q-gradient, this alone cannot be expected to appropriately capture the desired action coordination. Therefore, this paper constructs a three-step learning algorithm to encourage the action coordination. First, the source distribution of the drifting model is co-optimized as a diagonal policy model. This conditions the drifting model to attach the coordination, which cannot be expressed by a diagonal distribution, as residuals. Second, a discriminator model before and after drifting is introduced with adversarial training for a regularization term. This actively promotes the extraction of the coordination that fundamentally separates the two distributions. Third, best-of-N sampling is applied for action selection during rollouts in order to give directionality toward/beyond the regions where the coordination is insufficiently extracted/sufficiently discovered. The proposed method consistently improves the sample efficiency and the final control performance over the conventional diagonal distribution modeling across three locomotion tasks with high-dimensional action spaces. Furthermore, the analysis indicates that this improvement is achieved by reducing variance in certain action dimensions, effectively coupling them with other actions as action coordination.
abstract_zh: 为缓解强化学习（RL）处理高维动作空间的困难，本文提出一种轻量级策略模型及其训练算法。漂移模型（drifting model）能够隐式表示复杂分布，并通过单次前向传播生成动作，但仅依靠 Q 梯度进行反向传播，并不足以可靠地学到动作维度之间的协同关系。为此，作者设计了三步训练算法：首先，将漂移模型的源分布作为对角分布策略联合优化，使模型以残差形式补充对角分布无法表达的跨维度依赖；其次，引入判别器区分漂移前后的分布，并通过对抗训练施加正则化，促使模型提取能够区分两种分布的协同结构；最后，在轨迹采样（rollout）时使用 best-of-N 采样选择动作，引导策略探索协同尚未充分学到的区域，并在已发现协同的基础上进一步探索。在三项具有高维动作空间的运动控制任务中，该方法相比传统对角分布策略均提高了样本效率和最终控制性能。分析表明，性能提升与部分动作维度的方差降低及其与其他维度的有效耦合有关。
key_points_zh: 漂移模型可隐式表示复杂动作分布，并在单次前向传播中生成候选动作；仅用 Q 梯度训练不足以可靠地学习跨维度协同。
联合优化对角分布源策略，让漂移模型以残差补充跨维度依赖；再用对抗判别正则化突出漂移前后分布的协同差异。
在 rollout 阶段用 best-of-N 从候选动作中择优，引导策略探索尚未充分学到的协同，并拓展已发现的协同。
三项高维运动控制任务的样本效率和最终控制性能均优于对角分布基线；分析显示，部分动作维度的方差降低，并与其他维度形成有效耦合。
